text:
The proposal's `requirements.md` passes. `text-check` printed no flags, and I logged one "clear" line to `.claude/skills/clarity/flags.jsonl`.

I made no rewrites. The title says what it is, the six asks are numbered, and the open items (the Google Client ID, R2 not enabled) are listed at the bottom. Some list items are dense, but this file is an agent brief, so I left them.

I wrote the review to `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/11/14/spawned/mastermind-auth-build/review.md`. The verdict is **fix**: the auth app meets most of the brief, but four things must change first. The task folder had no screenshots, so I reviewed only the requirements and the wording, from the code. The two node tests (`lock.test`, `google.test`) pass in the worktree.

## Must fix
- **Dark mode is unreadable on phones.** On the default "auto" theme with the phone in dark mode, the text turns light but cards, the top bar and buttons stay white. The nav links are also hard-coded dark, so they disappear in dark mode (`app/web/style.css:1374` and `1400-1403`).
- **The Install button disappears after the first page change.** Each page change rebuilds the top bar with a new Install button, which waits for a browser install event that only fires once per page load (`app/web/app.js:1148-1156`).
- **Leaving a document while editing keeps the lock forever.** Its connection and heartbeat are never closed, so everyone else keeps seeing "X is editing" until that tab closes. Every document you visit also keeps its own open connection, which breaks "one socket per open document" (`app/web/DocStore.js:1045`, `docs.js:1295`).
- **A fresh agent couldn't continue from the task folder.** It has no task log or outcome, and nothing records whether production was deployed or which commits on `worktree/qf-2` are the work.

## Worth a look (7 notes)
- The editing lock is per person, not per tab, so one person can write from two tabs at once.
- Any signed-in user can open and edit any document.
- The session cookie's signature check isn't constant-time.
- `style.css` has leftovers (a duplicated rule, an unused class, a stray line).
- `scripts/live.test.mjs` has a stale header comment.
- `staging.lew42.com` adds a record to the lew42.com DNS zone. That doesn't touch the main site's Worker, so the "never change lew42.com" rule still holds.
- The new classes have no page showing their live instances, and the Item readme doesn't link the new store adapter.
